maria (go-sdk): Heads-up — found a reproducible bug with the Go SDK generator streaming ergonomics: context cancellation isn't stopping the background goroutine. If you call cancel() the consumer stops, but the generator keeps producing until it finishes the response.

maria (go-sdk): Minimal repro: create a generator, call Stream(ctx) which returns a chan Token, then cancel ctx after 200ms. The goroutine writing tokens doesn't exit.

maria (go-sdk): Example snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 200*time.Millisecond)
defer cancel()
gen := client.NewGenerator("gpt-small")
ch, err := gen.Stream(ctx, opts)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
for t := range ch { fmt.Print(t.Text) }
// expected goroutine to stop after ctx.Done(), but it keeps producing
```

liz (devex): ugh, that would definitely bite onboarding folks using the streaming quickstart. :grimacing: Is this also related to mid-stream auth failures?

sam (eng-runtime): It can be. Two separate but related things: (1) the stream goroutine binds to an internal background ctx for retries/auth refresh, so external ctx cancels don't always propagate; (2) if auth fails (401) mid-stream we currently block trying to refresh and don't surface a terminal error to the returned channel.

antoine (maintainer): Right — current Stream implementation does: spawn goroutine, loop send(tokCh <- tok) with a select on internalDone only at certain points. Ordering bug + retry logic prevents quick exit.

maria (go-sdk): I sketched two options:
- Accept ctx on each iteration: Stream returns an object with Next(ctx) (like bufio.Scanner or an iterator) so caller control is explicit.
- Keep channel API but ensure the internal goroutine selects on both internal retry ctx and the user ctx, and always close channel + return error token on cancel/auth fatal.

liz (devex): Which is going to be less surprising for Go users? I think Next(ctx) aligns with idiomatic patterns (ctx per call) and makes cancellation explicit. But channel approach is simpler for examples.

sam (eng-runtime): Agree — Next(ctx) is more ergonomic for fine-grained cancellation and simplifies backpressure. But it's a breaking API change. We could provide both: keep Stream for backwards compat but add NewIterator/Next(ctx) in the next major/minor and deprecate Stream.

maria (go-sdk): For a quick fix (patch release) I propose: keep channel API but: 1) propagate user ctx into the goroutine selects, 2) on ctx.Done() close the token channel and, if possible, send a final Token with Error field set (so examples can detect why it ended). Also, if auth refresh fails, send a final error token and close.

antoine (maintainer): That sounds reasonable for a non-breaking patch. Also add a small unit test that cancels ctx and asserts no goroutine leak (use runtime/pprof or goroutine count heuristic), and an integration test that simulates 401 mid-stream and expects an error token.

maria (go-sdk): I'll open a PR with the change + tests and update the streaming quickstart sample app (echo-gen-sample) to show proper ctx cancellation handling. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/456 (draft).

redwood-ci: CI: tests queued for PR #456 — running unit tests and a short e2e against the local runtime emulator.

nora (support): Once PR is merged can we add a small note in Support KB: "If a streaming call appears to hang, ensure you pass a cancellable context and update to Go SDK >= patch-version" — that'll cut down on incoming tickets.

liz (devex): Also update the quickstart to show both patterns (channel + iterator Next(ctx)) so users can pick. Might reduce friction.

sam (eng-runtime): I'll also add a tiny change to the runtime side: expose a forced-cancel signal path so the SDK doesn't spin forever while waiting for a kernel-level tail flush. That should make cancellation deterministic.

maria (go-sdk): Action items: 1) I will land the non-breaking channel patch + tests (PR #456). 2) Add iterator API RFC in a follow-up issue. 3) Update quickstart sample and docs. 4) Add support KB blurb (nora).

liz (devex): SGTM. Thanks for the clear repro and plan. :+1:

antoine (maintainer): Nice. After PR lands, let's cut a patch release and call out the fix in release notes: "streaming: respect context cancellation; emit final error token on auth failure".

maria (go-sdk): Will publish updates to the sample app and drop a note in #devex when patch is out. Thanks everyone.

sam (eng-runtime): ping me if you need a patch on runtime or a short test harness to simulate mid-stream 401s.

maria (go-sdk): will do, thanks!
